notes: Real weather icons. The Line and Solid sets were shapes drawn by hand here, and the cloud in particular did not read as a cloud. Both sets are now Bootstrap Icons — a proper icon family with matched outline and filled versions, so the two…
The clock face now takes the accent colour, matching the weather icon. Both are graphics rather than readings, so both follow the accent; the digital time stays text-coloured, because it is text.

A saved clock face now appears when the panel opens. It was drawn once using the defaults before the stored settings arrived, and nothing drew it again — so a chosen face only appeared if it was changed again after launch.
